title: From lab-scale to industrialization: atomically M–N–C catalysts for the oxygen reduction reaction
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2025, 18,3462-3501
DOI: 10.1039/D5EE00074B, Review Article
Tianyou Zhao, Jianjiang Wang, Yanrui Wei, Zechao Zhuang, Yuhai Dou, Jiarui Yang, Wen-Hao Li, Dingsheng Wang
This review focuses on the application of atomically M–N–C catalysts in the ORR, covering key pathways from laboratory synthesis to industrialization and providing an in-depth discussion on the major industrialization challenges.
